response.explanation: At line 4, src/presentation/server.ts imports PuckPayClient from the persistence layer. At lines 16-19 it constructs the client with the PUCKPAY_BASE_URL and PUCKPAY_API_KEY environment variables and passes it into the RinkService constructor. The file is the process entry point and acts as a composition root. It builds every persistence adapter (the session, booking and hire-stock repositories, PuckPay and DropText) and hands them to the business-layer RinkService. Then it starts the expiry timer and the HTTP app. The presentation code does not call PuckPay itself; the import is only there to wire dependencies together. FF-S03 still flags it. The rule only allows each layer to depend on the layer directly below it (presentation -> business -> persistence), and this edge goes from presentation straight to persistence. The same file has similar edges to other persistence modules (lines 1-3 and 5), so the pattern is structural rather than a one-off.
